script.text: Yuya, Yuri, Yugo, and Yuto united together to become the evil Z-ARC!
Why the long faces? It is I, Z-ARC! Didn't you wish for my return?
I'm back to give you what you want. A duel – a brutal duel – like no other!
Everything we did has led to this – the end of everything. But it's not too late to make up for our mistakes.
I know we can stop Z-ARC, but only if we work together. You are gonna help me, right Sora?
Not a chance! But if YOU wanna help ME take down Z-ARC, then I'm all in.
Pendulum, Xyz, Synchro, Fusion… With the mightiest power of each of the four dimensions combined, we are Supreme King Z-ARC!
Ahhh!
Aster, you take a break. Leave the rest to me.
Sora, don't worry about a thing.
I guess we're gonna have to pick up where those two left off!
Then let's get on with it, Kite!
You wasted my time! And now you'll pay the price!
Ahhh!
Yuya's seen better days.
That's Z-ARC. He's the worst o' the worst o' the worst and he's got Yuya under wraps.
Well then, if that thing has Yuya, let's defeat that monster and free him!
Gong's good with that!
I have to hand it to you, Jack. You're better than those other dolts I beat. But you're going down like all the rest!
Ahhh!
Jack – don't you worry about a thing! Not when Sylvio's arrived to steal the show!
Well, don't think I'm gonna let you hog the spotlight and upstage me.
None of you will stop me from conquering every dimension! Every one of you have failed so far! And so shall you two fools!
Ahhh!
Z-ARC, it's been awhile.
Ah, I remember you.
My ARC technology may have created realistic monsters, but there has never been a monster as horrifically real as you!
Now now. The crowd demanded more intense, more brutal duels. I only gave them what they wanted.
The people did not want this destruction!
I fear it's too late for me to change the past, but I can make up for my mistakes.
That's true, Father. But you don't have to do it alone.
